result: A sharper gradient lower bound and a telescoping bound on the trajectory length show that GD on randomly initialized deep ReLU networks reaches ε training loss once the width is Ω̃(n⁸L¹²/φ⁴) (down from n²⁴L¹²/φ⁸), in O(n²L² log(1/ε)/φ) iterations.
result_plain: Improved over-parameterization: GD converges for deep ReLU nets with width Ω̃(n^8 L^12/φ^4) instead of n^24.
